statement.zh: **协议**：DNSSEC 域名安全（DNS Security Extensions）。摘要一句话说清扩展对象：「The Domain Name System Security Extensions (DNSSEC) add data origin authentication and data integrity to the Domain Name System.」本文件是介绍与需求文档，新记录与协议改动由配套文档族规定。
statement.en: **Protocol**: DNS Security Extensions (DNSSEC 域名安全).The abstract states what the extensions add: "The Domain Name System Security Extensions (DNSSEC) add data origin authentication and data integrity to the Domain Name System." This document is the introduction and requirements; the new records and protocol modifications are specified by the companion document set.

statement.zh: §1 同时给出能力与不自称的能力：「The DNS security extensions provide origin authentication and integrity protection for DNS data, as well as a means of public key distribution.These extensions do not provide confidentiality.」即补齐的是来源与完整性，机密性被排除在设计之外。
statement.en: Section 1 gives both the capability and the disclaimer: "The DNS security extensions provide origin authentication and integrity protection for DNS data, as well as a means of public key distribution.These extensions do not provide confidentiality." Origin and integrity are added; confidentiality is excluded by design.

statement.zh: §3 列出协议改动：「DNSSEC adds four new resource record types: Resource Record Signature (RRSIG), DNS Public Key (DNSKEY), Delegation Signer (DS), and Next Secure (NSEC).It also adds two new message header bits: Checking Disabled (CD) and Authenticated Data (AD).」验证起点由 §2 的术语定义给出：「Trust Anchor: A configured DNSKEY RR or DS RR hash of a DNSKEY RR.」。
statement.en:
Section 3 lists the protocol changes: "DNSSEC adds four new resource record types: Resource Record Signature (RRSIG), DNS Public Key (DNSKEY), Delegation Signer (DS), and Next Secure (NSEC).It also adds two new message header bits: Checking Disabled (CD) and Authenticated Data (AD)." The starting point is defined in §2: "Trust Anchor: A configured DNSKEY RR or DS RR hash of a DNSKEY RR."

A shared name may belong to an algorithm, standard, event, person or term; this entry is responsible only for its catalogue binding and does not absorb adjacent records.

statement.zh: 自陈的边界有两处：§4 说明「Accordingly, DNSSEC is not designed to provide confidentiality, access control lists, or other means of differentiating between inquirers.」；可用性同样没有承诺——「DNSSEC provides no protection against denial of service attacks.」并指出验证签名会给解析器与权威服务器带来新的一类拒绝服务面。
statement.en: Two limits are stated outright: §4 says "Accordingly, DNSSEC is not designed to provide confidentiality, access control lists, or other means of differentiating between inquirers.", and availability is not claimed either — "DNSSEC provides no protection against denial of service attacks." — with signature verification itself creating a new denial-of-service surface.

statement.zh:
RFC 4033 头部为 R.Arends（Telematica Instituut）、R.Austein（ISC）、M.Larson（VeriSign）、D.Massey（Colorado State University）与 S.Rose（NIST），类别 Standards Track，2005 年 3 月；头部同时列出取代的九份文档（以 2535 开头）与更新的九份文档（以 1034、1035 开头），这两串清单在文本里与作者栏交错排版，故此处不逐字引用。**技术参数与复算边界**

本条的形式模型是 \(\mathrm{Adv}^{\Pi}_A(\lambda)\le n\cdot\mathrm{Adv}^{\mathrm{prf}}_F(\lambda)+\varepsilon_{\mathrm{aead}}(\lambda)\)。输入：输入：DNSSEC 域名安全的公开参数、密钥/随机数与消息；变量说明：Π 协议，A 敌手，n 会话数，PRF/AEAD 为底层原语。
statement.en: The RFC 4033 header lists R.Arends (Telematica Instituut), R.
